text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's mother is coming to visit in
a few
days, so I make a suggestion after
one of our
outings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The next one? The one Mayano said
she's running
in?
choice_data_list: 次の模擬レースに出てみないか？
次の模擬レースに出てみない？
choice_data_list_en: Why don't you try entering the next mock race?
Why don't you try entering the next mock race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she's coming all this way, we might
as well
show her a race. Besides, with
Nature's current
skills, she has what it
takes to win.
choice_data_list: ああ。ネイチャのお母さんが来る日だし
うん。ネイチャのお母さんが来る日だし
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. After all, it's the day Nature's mom is visiting.
Yeah. Nature's mom is visiting today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... And you won't accept no as an answer, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess I have no choice. I'll join. I don't
know if I
can beat Mayano, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. Right before the
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Mom and Trainer are both here, waving
at me
from the audience... It's just like
elementary
school!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I can't mess this up.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I'm going to win today's race
too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(I knew Mayano would rush out from the

beginning. Just as expected, she's pace
chasing.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we planned in the pre-race briefing,
Nice
Nature is staying on Mayano Top
Gun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No way...
choice_data_list: でも心なしかペースが速いような？
choice_data_list_en: Still, doesn't the pace feel a little fast?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... All right, might as well get started. Time for takeoff!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(No way, she's accelerating now?! So she
wasn't
pace chasing, but front running?!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Darn it, the strategy is all off! If I let her
keep
going... I'll lose!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Darn it aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature dashes out of the group to
follow
after Mayano Top Gun, but she
loses her pace in
the process and ends
up in third place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, Nice Nature's mother seems happy
to see
how far her daughter has come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since the scrimmage
ended, but
Nature is nowhere to be
seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't see her anywhere in the academy.
Maybe
she went outside? According to
her mother, she
would often go to the
riverbank to sulk when she
felt sad.
choice_data_list: お母さんはカフェで待ってもらうとして……
choice_data_list_en: We can have your mom wait at a cafe, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Have you been looking for
me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for getting your hopes up for
nothing! I'm
just the same old me, always
third place! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for getting your hopes up for
nothing! I'm
just the same old me, always
third place! Hahaha!
choice_data_list: そうだね
無理して笑うことはない
無理して笑うことはない
よし！気晴らしに行こう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah.
You don't have to force a smile.
You don't have to force a smile.
All right! Let's go blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: そうだね
無理して笑うことはない
無理して笑うことはない
よし！気晴らしに行こう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah.
You don't have to force a smile.
You don't have to force a smile.
All right! Let's go blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...So what?
choice_data_list: いつもの一生懸命で素敵なネイチャだった
choice_data_list_en: You were your usual hardworking, wonderful self, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You say I gave it my best, but my best is

worthless if I still lose!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to win this race... I had to win this race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that her mother felt her
determination.
choice_data_list: でも、お母さんは嬉しそうだったよ
choice_data_list_en: Still, your mom looked really happy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... still... It's really frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I cried way too much. Someone my age should not be crying like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trust me, it's all out! Come on, let's go
back to
my mom.
choice_data_list: もっと甘えていいのに
choice_data_list_en: You could stand to lean on me more, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Nice Nature having regained her

composure, we go back to see her
mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature acts embarrassed while they
talk but
wears a happy smile on her face
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm not forcing anyth—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺は悔しいし、君に勝ってもらいたかった
私は悔しいし、貴方に勝ってもらいたかった
choice_data_list_en: I'm frustrated too, and I wanted you to win.
I'm frustrated too. I really wanted you to win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I think I got cocky after going step for
step with
Mayano when we were partner
running.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And when she praised my speed, I didn't
take into
account that she was also
sizing me up...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Mayano really is on another level. She's a smart one...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I bet she doesn't know what this
feels like.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't get me wrong! I like Mayano,
of course.
It's me that I don't like.
choice_data_list: ネイチャ……
choice_data_list_en: Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm just narrow-minded, ignorant, and...
plain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I reassure her that I'm here to help her
get past
anything that's troubling her.
We're a team, after
all.
choice_data_list: 俺はそれでもいいと思う
私はそれでもいいと思う
choice_data_list_en: I think that's fine too.
I think that's fine too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And what if that doesn't work?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Hahaha! You're funny.
choice_data_list: 2人一緒にここでしょぼくれようか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we mope here together, just the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking a moment to compose
herself, we
head back to her waiting
mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature acts embarrassed while they
talk but
wears a happy smile on her face
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah? Like what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring a befuddled Nice Nature to one
of her
favorite spots—the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that you've brought me here,
what are
we doing exactly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go buy some taiyaki.
choice_data_list: 落ち込んだ時は食べるに限る！
choice_data_list_en: When you're feeling down, nothing beats good food!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I do. I was just remembering how my
mom always
bought me one when I was
feeling down.
choice_data_list: もしかして苦手だった？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, was that not your thing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, both of you really know how to
lay it on
thick.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Worried, huh? I guess I worried Mom
again back
there.
choice_data_list: それだけネイチャが心配なんだよ
choice_data_list_en: That's just how worried I am about you, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should get her some taiyaki
too, as an
apology gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head back to her mother with a bag
of taiyaki
in hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature acts embarrassed while they
talk but
wears a happy smile on her face
the whole time.
